root_cause: The header component initializes aria-expanded based solely on the presence of 'govuk-header__navigation--open' class, but on desktop the navigation is visibly displayed without this class (the menu button is hidden via CSS). This causes aria-expanded='true' and aria-hidden='false' incorrectly, hiding navigation links from assistive technology.
repair_strategy: Modify Header.prototype.init to detect desktop vs mobile by checking if the menu button is visible (getComputedStyle display !== 'none'). On desktop (button hidden), set aria-expanded='false' and aria-hidden='false' directly and skip click listener. On mobile, use existing logic with '--open' class and add click listener.
expected_accessibility_effect: On desktop, the navigation links are exposed as links in the accessibility tree with aria-hidden='false', and the menu button has aria-expanded='false'. Keyboard and screen reader users can reach and activate all navigation links. Mobile toggle behavior unchanged.
functional_risks: Minimal; change only affects desktop initialization where button is hidden. Mobile toggle behavior unchanged.
getComputedStyle may force layout but only runs once on init.
verification_requirements: Run the existing journey test; ensure ax assertions for "Apply", "Renew a licence", "Fishing rules" pass.
Verify mobile toggle still works (manual check).
Confirm aria-expanded='false' and aria-hidden='false' on desktop.
